subject: [PATCH v5 19/22] exfat: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the exfat file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which replaces the need for separate ->iomap_begin and ->iomap_end callbacks. The conversion is done using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next helper to ensure proper cleanup of previous mappings. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
